subtopics.name: Execution Context & Call Stack
subtopics.description: Creation phase vs Execution phase; hoisting of var and function declarations.
subtopics.explanation: During creation phase, memory is allocated for variables and functions. Execution phase runs the code line-by-line.

subtopics.name: Lexical Environment & Scope Chain
subtopics.description: How nested functions search outer environments for unresolved identifiers.
subtopics.explanation: Every execution context has a reference to its outer lexical environment, forming the scope chain.

subtopics.name: Closure Mechanics & V8 Heap Retention
subtopics.description: Why variables survive when a function completes execution.
subtopics.explanation: If an inner function outlives its enclosing function (e.g., returned or passed as callback), the enclosed variables are preserved in heap memory.

subtopics.name: Practical Implementation: Memoize & Counter
subtopics.description: Build a private counter and a memoize wrapper.
subtopics.explanation: const memoize = fn => { const cache = {}; return (...args) => { const k = JSON.stringify(args); return cache[k] ??= fn(...args); }; };
